scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.restart: sh -c 'CI= DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true npm --prefix frontend run build && (lsof -ti:5003 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; true) && npm --prefix backend start'
scripts.install-all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
